PSO GAMECUBE / XBOX DROP DATABASE
=================================

PURPOSE
Complete packaged GameCube/Xbox drop records. Each DROP block is one imported row and includes platform, Episode, difficulty, area, enemy, Section ID, item, rate, expected kills, rare-enemy flag, and derived probabilities when supplied.

SOURCE BASIS
PSOGC Drop Charts packaged in pso-drops-full.json.

RETRIEVAL RULE
Treat explicit platform labels, verification/status fields, source labels, and warnings as part of the fact. Never silently remove them.
